description: Parking Spaces is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Leicester City Council. The number of marked out controlled on and off-street parking spaces. The information is published annually. The list is for information only. Amendments to on street parking restrictions are ongoing. It is the driver's responsibility to ensure that they park in accordance with the restrictions in force on the street at the time of parking. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read).
